Before you drop by

A few things
you might wonder.

Useful answers from the supplied café information. For anything more specific, a quick call is the best next step.

Where is Bahattar Cafe?

Bahattar Cafe is in Itahari, Koshi Province 56705, Nepal. The precise street address has not been supplied. See location and directions for the supplied Google Maps listing.

When is the café open?

Supplied hours are 8:00 AM–9:00 PM Sunday through Thursday, and 8:00 AM–9:30 PM Friday and Saturday. These need owner confirmation before launch. Check all weekly hours and call before a special trip.

Where can I see the menu and prices?

Use the complete searchable menu to browse all 66 supplied items across 15 categories. All listed prices are in Nepalese Rupees (NPR). Availability and prices may change.

What is the average spend per person?

The supplied estimate is Rs. 500–1,000 per person. This is a reported average, not a fixed price. Your total depends on what you order and any applicable charges confirmed by the café.

Are there vegetarian choices?

The supplied menu names options including Veggie Lover pizza, Veg Burger, Veg Sandwich, Veg Fried Rice, Veg Noodles, Paneer Chilli, and veg momo. Ask about ingredients and preparation for your specific dietary needs; an item name does not confirm vegan suitability or allergen safety.

Is breakfast available all day?

Breakfast is listed on the menu, but serving times have not been confirmed. Call 982-0347351 before visiting for a specific breakfast item.

Can I order online or book a table here?

This website provides menu and visitor information. Online ordering, delivery, and reservations have not been confirmed. Contact the café directly to ask what is available.

Are Wi-Fi, parking, and card payments available?

Those facilities and payment methods have not been confirmed. Please call the café for current information.

How should I check allergens?

Only some menu items have supplied ingredient descriptions. Speak to the café about ingredients, substitutions, and shared preparation equipment before ordering. This website does not guarantee allergen-free preparation.

How do I contact Bahattar Cafe?

Call 982-0347351. You can also use the contact page and directions page to plan your visit.
